description.zh:
如何在 C++ 中讀寫資料

每個程式最終都在處理資料，因此必須知道如何在程式中輸入與輸出。輸出使用 cout（需 #include <iostream>，通常也寫 using namespace std;）：

cout << 5 + 10 << endl;
cout << 3 * 7 << endl;
cout << 37 / 3 << endl;   // 兩個 int 相除
cout << 37 % 3 << endl;   // 餘數

讀入資料使用 cin。讀一整行文字（含空格）可用 getline(cin, name)（需 #include <string>）：

string name;
cout << "What is your name?" << endl;
getline(cin, name);
cout << "Hi " << name << "!" << endl;

範例輸入

John

輸出

What is your name?
Hi John!

數字相加 vs 字串連接

試著寫一個程式：讀入兩個數字並輸出它們的和。若用 getline 讀入字串再相加：

string a, b;
getline(cin, a);
getline(cin, b);
cout << a + b << endl;

範例輸入

5
7

輸出

57

結果是 57 而不是 12！因為 + 在兩個 string 之間代表字串連接，不是數字相加。

在 C++ 中，5（int）與 "5"（string）是不同型別。要把輸入當成整數運算，請用 int 搭配 cin >>：

int a, b;
cin >> a >> b;
cout << a + b << endl;

範例輸入

5
7

輸出

12

小提示：若前面用過 cin >> 再改用 getline，中間可能需要 cin.ignore() 吃掉換行字元。本章題目會用到 cout、cin 與整數/字串的差異。閱讀完畢後，點選「下一題」開始練習。
description.en:
How to read and write in C++

Every program is eventually a data processor, so we need to know how to input and output data. Use cout (#include <iostream>, often with using namespace std;):

cout << 5 + 10 << endl;
cout << 3 * 7 << endl;
cout << 37 / 3 << endl;   // int division
cout << 37 % 3 << endl;   // remainder

Read input with cin. For a full line of text (including spaces), use getline(cin, name) (#include <string>):

string name;
cout << "What is your name?" << endl;
getline(cin, name);
cout << "Hi " << name << "!" << endl;

Sample input

John

Output

What is your name?
Hi John!

Sum of numbers and strings

Try a program that reads two numbers and prints their sum. If you use getline and add strings:

string a, b;
getline(cin, a);
getline(cin, b);
cout << a + b << endl;

Sample input

5
7

Output

57

The result is 57, not 12! With two string values, + means concatenation, not numeric addition.

In C++, 5 (int) and "5" (string) are different types. For integer math, use int with cin >>:

int a, b;
cin >> a >> b;
cout << a + b << endl;

Sample input

5
7

Output

12

Tip: after cin >>, you may need cin.ignore() before getline to consume the newline. Exercises use cout, cin, and the int/string difference. When ready, click Next below.
